en:
1
00:00:09,770 --> 00:00:16,270
Snow is coming down... I'm almost home

2
00:00:23,517 --> 00:00:31,030
Six hours on the highway with the radio low

3
00:00:31,130 --> 00:00:38,070
Practiced every answer that I thought she'd want to know

4
00:00:38,170 --> 00:00:45,510
I was gonna say I'm happy, say the year went well

5
00:00:45,610 --> 00:00:52,470
But she opens up the door before I ring the bell

6
00:00:52,570 --> 00:00:57,430
She doesn't ask about the money or how the year has been

7
00:00:57,530 --> 00:01:02,310
She just takes my winter coat and pulls me in

8
00:01:02,410 --> 00:01:06,270
She says "have you eaten yet?" with the oven still warm

9
00:01:06,370 --> 00:01:09,990
Like a lighthouse on a hill in the middle of a storm

10
00:01:10,090 --> 00:01:13,830
I can carry the whole world till the moment I walk in

11
00:01:13,930 --> 00:01:16,838
And that one little question makes me little again

12
00:01:16,938 --> 00:01:21,166
She says "have you eaten yet?" and she's pulling out a chair

13
00:01:21,266 --> 00:01:24,750
Like the years were only minutes and I never left there

14
00:01:24,850 --> 00:01:28,813
I can carry the whole world till the moment I walk in

15
00:01:28,913 --> 00:01:36,050
And that one little question makes me little again

16
00:01:36,150 --> 00:01:43,590
Dad is acting like he didn't wait up half the night

17
00:01:43,690 --> 00:01:50,870
But he's standing by the window with the porch light bright

18
00:01:50,970 --> 00:01:58,630
I keep telling everybody I can make it on my own

19
00:01:58,730 --> 00:02:06,070
But I've never had a supper like the ones back home

20
00:02:06,170 --> 00:02:10,337
She doesn't ask about the money or how the year has been

21
00:02:10,437 --> 00:02:15,430
She just takes my winter coat and pulls me in

22
00:02:15,530 --> 00:02:19,191
She says "have you eaten yet?" with the oven still warm

23
00:02:19,291 --> 00:02:23,190
Like a lighthouse on a hill in the middle of a storm

24
00:02:23,290 --> 00:02:26,890
I can carry the whole world till the moment I walk in

25
00:02:26,990 --> 00:02:31,750
And that one little question makes me little again

26
00:02:31,850 --> 00:02:39,270
Out there no one ever notices the meals I miss

27
00:02:39,370 --> 00:02:46,790
Out there no one ever worries in a way like this

28
00:02:46,890 --> 00:02:52,210
Every Christmas I come running back the same

29
00:02:52,310 --> 00:03:00,010
To the only door that opens when I say my name

30
00:03:00,110 --> 00:03:04,413
She says "have you eaten yet?" and she's pulling out a chair

31
00:03:04,513 --> 00:03:08,170
Like the years were only minutes and I never left there

32
00:03:08,270 --> 00:03:11,942
I can carry the whole world till the moment I walk in

33
00:03:12,042 --> 00:03:18,920
And that one little question makes me little again

34
00:03:19,400 --> 00:03:26,400
Have you eaten yet...

35
00:03:26,900 --> 00:03:34,600
yeah, I'm home
tr:
1
00:00:09,770 --> 00:00:16,270
Kar yağıyor... neredeyse evdeyim

2
00:00:23,517 --> 00:00:31,030
Otoyolda altı saat, radyo kısık

3
00:00:31,130 --> 00:00:38,070
Onun bilmek isteyeceğini sandığım her cevabı prova ettim

4
00:00:38,170 --> 00:00:45,510
Mutluyum diyecektim, yıl iyi geçti diyecektim

5
00:00:45,610 --> 00:00:52,470
Ama ben zile basmadan o kapıyı açıyor

6
00:00:52,570 --> 00:00:57,430
Ne paradan soruyor ne de yılın nasıl geçtiğinden

7
00:00:57,530 --> 00:01:02,310
Sadece kışlık montumu alıp beni içeri çekiyor

8
00:01:02,410 --> 00:01:06,270
"Yemek yedin mi?" diyor, fırın hâlâ sıcak

9
00:01:06,370 --> 00:01:09,990
Fırtınanın ortasında tepedeki bir deniz feneri gibi

10
00:01:10,090 --> 00:01:13,830
İçeri girdiğim ana kadar bütün dünyayı taşıyabilirim

11
00:01:13,930 --> 00:01:16,838
Ve o küçük soru beni yeniden küçücük yapıyor

12
00:01:16,938 --> 00:01:21,166
"Yemek yedin mi?" diyor ve bir sandalye çekiyor

13
00:01:21,266 --> 00:01:24,750
Sanki yıllar sadece dakikaymış ve ben hiç gitmemişim gibi

14
00:01:24,850 --> 00:01:28,813
İçeri girdiğim ana kadar bütün dünyayı taşıyabilirim

15
00:01:28,913 --> 00:01:36,050
Ve o küçük soru beni yeniden küçücük yapıyor

16

Babam gecenin yarısına kadar beklememiş gibi yapıyor

17
00:01:43,690 --> 00:01:50,870
Ama pencerenin önünde duruyor, kapı lambası yanık

18
00:01:50,970 --> 00:01:58,630
Herkese kendi başıma idare edebilirim deyip duruyorum

19
00:01:58,730 --> 00:02:06,070
Ama evdeki gibi bir akşam yemeği hiç yemedim

20

26
00:02:31,850 --> 00:02:39,270
Dışarıda kimse atladığım öğünleri fark etmiyor

27
00:02:39,370 --> 00:02:46,790
Dışarıda kimse böyle merak etmiyor beni

28
00:02:46,890 --> 00:02:52,210

29
00:02:52,310 --> 00:03:00,010

31

32

33
00:03:12,042 --> 00:03:18,920

34
00:03:19,400 --> 00:03:26,400
Yemek yedin mi...

35
00:03:26,900 --> 00:03:34,600
evet, evdeyim
